response.overview: In conjunction with the exhibit opening of “Olivia Rodrigo: the cure unraveled,” the Grammy Museum is thrilled to welcome three-time Grammy Award-winning artist Olivia Rodrigo to the Museum’s Ray Charles Rooftop Terrace for an evening celebrating and discussing her newest critically acclaimed album, you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love, her creative process, career, upcoming tour, and more. Attendees will have an opportunity to enjoy rooftop views, a café with food, and a cash bar prior and will have the chance to view the exhibit post-program.
response.title: An Evening With Olivia Rodrigo
